api_keys_read_only_until_check.name: api_keys_read_only_until_check
api_keys_read_only_until_check.value: "api_keys"."read_only_until" IS NULL OR "api_keys"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL

platform_mfa_credentials_kind_check.name: platform_mfa_credentials_kind_check
platform_mfa_credentials_kind_check.value: ("platform_mfa_credentials"."kind" = 'webauthn' AND "platform_mfa_credentials"."public_key" IS NOT NULL AND "platform_mfa_credentials"."encrypted_secret" IS NULL) OR ("platform_mfa_credentials"."kind" = 'totp' AND "platform_mfa_credentials"."encrypted_secret" IS NOT NULL AND "platform_mfa_credentials"."public_key" IS NULL)

print_jobs_payload_contract_check.name: print_jobs_payload_contract_check
print_jobs_payload_contract_check.value:
jsonb_typeof("print_jobs"."payload") = 'object' AND (
    (COALESCE("print_jobs"."payload"->>'type', '') = 'raw' AND COALESCE("print_jobs"."payload"->>'protocol', '') in ('raw','escpos','zpl','tspl'))
    OR (COALESCE("print_jobs"."payload"->>'type', '') = 'escpos' AND COALESCE("print_jobs"."payload"->>'protocol', '') = 'escpos')
    OR (COALESCE("print_jobs"."payload"->>'type', '') = 'pdf' AND COALESCE("print_jobs"."payload"->>'protocol', '') = '')
    OR (COALESCE("print_jobs"."payload"->>'type', '') = 'image' AND COALESCE("print_jobs"."payload"->>'protocol', '') = '')
  )

printers_type_check.name: printers_type_check
printers_type_check.value:
"printers"."printer_type" = 'physical'
    AND lower(COALESCE("printers"."name",'')) !~ '(microsoft print to pdf|onenote|xps document writer|pdf24|pdfcreator|virtual printer|print to pdf|remote desktop easy print|redirected)'
    AND lower(COALESCE("printers"."config"->>'spooler_name',"printers"."config"->>'address','')) !~ '(microsoft print to pdf|onenote|xps document writer|pdf24|pdfcreator|virtual printer|print to pdf|remote desktop easy print|redirected)'
    AND lower(COALESCE("printers"."capabilities"->>'driver_name',"printers"."capabilities"->>'driverName','')) !~ '(microsoft print to pdf|onenote|xps document writer|pdf24|pdfcreator|virtual printer|print to pdf|remote desktop easy print|redirected)'
    AND lower(COALESCE("printers"."capabilities"->>'port_name','')) !~ '^(portprompt:|xpsport:|file:|nul:|null:|shrfax:|fax:)'
    AND lower(COALESCE("printers"."capabilities"->>'printer_class','')) NOT IN ('virtual','redirected')
    AND NOT COALESCE("printers"."config" ? 'virtual_test_sink', false)
    AND NOT COALESCE("printers"."config" ? 'virtual_spooler_test', false)
    AND NOT COALESCE("printers"."capabilities" @> '{"virtual":true}'::jsonb, false)
    AND NOT COALESCE("printers"."capabilities" @> '{"is_virtual":true}'::jsonb, false)
    AND NOT COALESCE("printers"."capabilities" @> '{"virtual_test_sink":true}'::jsonb, false)
    AND NOT COALESCE("printers"."capabilities" @> '{"virtual_spooler_test":true}'::jsonb, false)

refresh_tokens_kind_scope_check.name: refresh_tokens_kind_scope_check
refresh_tokens_kind_scope_check.value:
("refresh_tokens"."kind" = 'platform' AND "refresh_tokens"."tenant_id" IS NULL AND "refresh_tokens"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "refresh_tokens"."role" IS NULL)
    OR
    ("refresh_tokens"."kind" IN ('manager', 'customer') AND "refresh_tokens"."tenant_id" IS NOT NULL AND "refresh_tokens"."role" IS NOT NULL)

workspace_mfa_challenges_scope_check.name: workspace_mfa_challenges_scope_check
workspace_mfa_challenges_scope_check.value: "workspace_mfa_challenges"."kind" IN ('customer','manager') AND (("workspace_mfa_challenges"."purpose" IN ('login','recover') AND "workspace_mfa_challenges"."session_family_id" IS NULL AND "workspace_mfa_challenges"."session_id" IS NULL) OR ("workspace_mfa_challenges"."purpose" IN ('stepup','manage') AND "workspace_mfa_challenges"."session_family_id" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_mfa_challenges"."session_id" IS NOT NULL))

workspace_mfa_credentials_kind_check.name: workspace_mfa_credentials_kind_check
workspace_mfa_credentials_kind_check.value: ("workspace_mfa_credentials"."kind" = 'webauthn' AND "workspace_mfa_credentials"."public_key" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_mfa_credentials"."encrypted_secret" IS NULL) OR ("workspace_mfa_credentials"."kind" = 'totp' AND "workspace_mfa_credentials"."encrypted_secret" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_mfa_credentials"."public_key" IS NULL)

workspace_session_security_mfa_check.name: workspace_session_security_mfa_check
workspace_session_security_mfa_check.value: ("workspace_session_security"."mfa_version" IS NULL AND "workspace_session_security"."mfa_method" IS NULL AND "workspace_session_security"."mfa_verified_at" IS NULL) OR ("workspace_session_security"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_session_security"."mfa_version" > 0 AND "workspace_session_security"."mfa_method" IN ('webauthn','totp') AND "workspace_session_security"."mfa_verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_session_security"."mfa_verified_at" < "workspace_session_security"."expires_at")
